This area is occupied by enemies.

3.DisplayDes: Here rests Elreth The Defender. May he be forever remembered for his great deeds within the forest. May all who visit this sacred land receive his blessing.

4.DisplayDes: Here lies the stoic Ilydent, master of magic and pursuer of truth. May his spirit protect these lands forever more.

5.DisplayDes:
This area is occupied by formidable enemies. 
You must defeat them to earn passage through here.

6.DisplayDes: This fountain seems to be emanating some sort of alluring magic... Its water seems to have healing properties... I feel revitalized!

7.DisplayDes: May the faithful Thelarion, master swordsman and founder of the Dusk Patrol rest in peace.

8.DisplayDes: An encampment full of all different types of adventurers.

9.DisplayDes: Strange stone slabs block the way forward. You can vaguely make out what is written on them. It seems to be an ancient text which refers to the Dusk Patrollers.

10.DisplayDes:
This area is occupied by fearsome adversaries. 
You must defeat them to earn passage through here.

11.DisplayDes: It illuminates a dazzling brilliance, perhaps it's bright enough to wake the fallen from their slumber.

12.DisplayDes: The Orb of Fire, responsible for maintaining the balance of fire magic is emanating a strange demonic magic. It seems to have been corrupted by something malevolent.

13.DisplayDes: A magical fire that is blocking your passage.

14.DisplayDes: The Orb of Wind maintains the balance of wind magic.

15.DisplayDes: The Bastion of the Elements, a place where nature and magic collide. Each element contains its own potent magical force. Thus to control these forces of nature, the oracles of the forest created the four orbs, the orb of water, fire, wind and earth. With the creation of the orbs came the birth of a long, tranquil peace within the forest. A balance between the elements had been established.

16.DisplayDes: Legend has it, that those who touch the four elemental orbs will receive their blessings. Only those that possess the four blessings of the elements are permitted entry to its hidden areas.

17.DisplayDes: The Orb of Earth maintains the balance of earth magic.

18.DisplayDes: A damaged water orb that has lost most of its magical power.

19.DisplayDes: The restored Orb of Water, now brimming with magic. The Orb of Water maintains the balance of water magic.

20.DisplayDes: The Orb of Fire, that maintains the balance of fire magic has been cleansed of all demonic magic.

21.DisplayDes: Thick vines that block the way forward

22.DisplayDes: It is said that only those who have earned the forest's respect may adorn its artifacts.

23.DisplayDes: Do battle using only Wilder heroes to earn the forest's respect and open up a hidden path.

24.DisplayDes: The enemy army's provisions are stored here. This is the enemy's lifeline.

25.DisplayDes:
A Lightbearer village.
Just more victims of the war.

26.DisplayDes: A lever that is currently pointing to the image of the moon.

27.DisplayDes:
"When the sun rises, the moon descends."
 "When the moon ascends, the sun falls"

28.DisplayDes: There doesn't seem to be a way to open this door from the outside.

29.DisplayDes: A pillar that has risen from the ground. It has an image of the moon painted on it.

30.DisplayDes: "Levers and pillars are connected. Their color is the key to the riddle."

31.DisplayDes: A magical portal. I wonder where it leads?

33.DisplayDes: A guardian awakened by the portal.

40.DisplayDes:
There are still more guardians protecting the seals.
They must all be slain before we can gain entry to this.

41.DisplayDes: A great heat can be felt coming off of this structure. However it's blocking the path ahead, the only option is to destroy it to advance.

42.DisplayDes: A scout is awaiting our arrival here.

44.DisplayDes: An unknown fiery magic courses through the rock. An ice-imbued weapon is required to destroy it.

47.DisplayDes: A great hammer that is imbued with a fiery magic. It can be used to destroy icy objects.

52.DisplayDes: The pond's magical waters have been known to produce mysterious treasures from time to time. But be wary, these treasures are a highly sought after commodity.

55.DisplayDes: This rune seems to have some kind of connection with the evil that lurks here. Use with caution.

56.DisplayDes: A great heat can be felt coming from this fire altar, destroying it will incinerate the nearby enemies...

57.DisplayDes: A switch. It looks as if it can be activated by pressing down on it.

59.DisplayDes: An abandoned cabin, another victim to time, it looks as if it could be pushed over with one breath.

60.DisplayDes: An old, abandoned cannon. From the looks of things, it wasn't created by any mortal man.

61.DisplayDes: The fallen champions of Bantus that once perished here were re-awoken by the thundering cannons of war. With their eternal slumber interrupted, the fallen few now roam these lands, forever awaiting the true king of Bantus to return to his throne.

65.DisplayDes: A cannon that can only be fired once.

66.DisplayDes: A force to be reckoned with.

77.DisplayDes: A simple brazier by which can be easily lit.

78.DisplayDes: Fross can't stand anything that gives off heat! A fire?! Fire! Another fire? Argh!

79.DisplayDes: From what I've observed, ice elementals cannot stand fire. They just need to get a whiff of flame and they'll throw all the ice and snow they have at it. Fortunately, they don't actively go out of their way to harass passersby, but I'd imagine anyone cooking on an open flame out here would be in a lot of danger. You'll see a telltale frosting wherever the ice elementals have been. They will pretty much shrug off any ordinary damage, so it looks like you'll have to try drive them into the binding seal before you can do anything else.

80.DisplayDes: How come... I can't even... move an inch...?

90.DisplayDes: I'm not sure why, but there seems to be something strange about the inhabitants of the village to the south.

91.DisplayDes: How exactly do we define "evil"? Just because some folk don't share our beliefs, we call them "heretics". How can a person that is deaf to other's opinions and blind to other's cultures be called righteous and divine? It's not these creatures that are terrifying, it's the people that think in this way. I'm writing this as the real demons approach our location. We have doomed this town and ourselves.

A giant, shiny, golden egg.

It seems to have a deep connection to the dream's host.

176.DisplayDes:
One of several Aspirations that are scattered throughout the dreamscape.
It contains the messy handwriting of the dream's host.

177.DisplayDes:
A steam engine that has been modified into a cannon. Used by the Dwarfs to expand the ice sheets in the area, they invented the Zanger Steam Cannon, which, with the use of a mysterious magic is able to turn snow into water, and then water into ice.
"Snow and ice are the foundation of our revolution" — The Dwarven Revolution

178.DisplayDes: A magical turret that can launch giant fireballs into the air.

This portal is only capable of one-way travel.

A giant stone gate located at the center of the Fractured Gallery.

185.DisplayDes: The Forsaken Brand will have an ongoing negative impact on intruders, as punishment for their blasphemy towards the gods.

186.DisplayDes: Its full name, "The Lightbearer Associated Chambers of Commerce Guild Division" is plenty long enough. It is said that it is impossible to separate the wealthiest people in the realm from this place. Truly impressive.

187.DisplayDes: Martial law dictates anybody without a permit cannot pass.

188.DisplayDes: In memory of the brave warriors who sacrificed themselves to uphold peace on the Imperial Borders.

189.DisplayDes: Peace and tranquility have been brought about by the Bonds of Brotherhood shared by the Lightbearer people and Mauler inhabitants.

190.DisplayDes: The trade district is thriving, all kinds of business and shops are here, not to mention the throngs of people.

191.DisplayDes: Exquisite ruins are still ruins, but calling them "exquisite" feels almost comical.

192.DisplayDes: Ah, the peaceful residential district with its distinct taste of home.

193.DisplayDes: A dense forest. There's no direct way through.

194.DisplayDes: A normal little hut hidden in the forest, but hiding in the forest is not particularly normal, is it?

195.DisplayDes: This little cabin, well-hidden by the dense forest, has been unoccupied for a long time. Given a bit of a tidy up, it may yet prove useful.

196.DisplayDes: The well-intentioned owner of the inn offers travelers a place to take a rest. It's an affordable, clean and conscientiously run business.

197.DisplayDes: Originally a place for those traversing the forest to catch respite, it was an unfortunate casualty of the revolt. Nothing but ruins now remains.

198.DisplayDes: The sole entrance to the Mauler village, watched by incorruptible, steadfast guards... Suspicious individuals will not be permitted to pass.

203.DisplayDes: This building is the "lucky" sole survivor of the disaster, truly miraculous. But something about it seems out of place.

204.DisplayDes: The well-intentioned owner of the inn used to offer travelers a place to take a rest. But now without staff to run it, you'll just have to improvise with what's available.

205.DisplayDes: Choose one of the Old Man's methods.
